assets.title: M31 in GALEX NUV ultraviolet (SkyView)

band.colourNote: Single-band ultraviolet intensity shown as log-scaled greyscale; ultraviolet is invisible to the eye, and young hot stars dominate. No colour table applied.

assets.credit: Data: GALEX (Galaxy Evolution Explorer), NASA, via the MAST GALEX archive; reprojected by NASA SkyView (HEASARC, NASA/GSFC).

licence.name: Public domain (as stated by SkyView for GALEX)
licence.evidence: SkyView survey description (also in the FITS header): 'Provenance: All data is downloaded from the MAST GALEX archive. Copyright: Public domain.'

observation.instrument: NUV channel, SkyView survey 'GALEX Near UV', bandpass 1.05-1.69 PHz

processing: Rendered by NASA SkyView from GALEX NUV mosaics with request parameters: Position=10.6847,41.2687, Survey=GALEX Near UV, Pixels=2048, Size=3.2, Projection=Tan, Coordinates=J2000, Return=JPEG, Scaling=Log, Sampler=LI, Cmap=Grey. Output is a TAN-projection greyscale JPEG, north up, east left, centred on the requested position (verified on a FITS request with the same geometry: CTYPE RA---TAN/DEC--TAN, CRVAL = request centre, CRPIX at image centre, CDELT1 negative, CDELT2 positive, no rotation).
Intensity is log-scaled by SkyView's JPEG writer with its default range; GALEX tile boundaries and exposure differences show as visible patches and noise.
Single-band GALEX mosaic; the field is cut by the survey footprint at its edges.
